text:
**Date:** The board's decision was announced on 12 March, effective 1 April.

**Named person:** Margit Osterlund, chair of the Varnholt Logistics board, confirmed the appointment and said Feltz was chosen after a seven-month search.

**Figure:** Feltz will oversee a workforce of 4,300 employees across 11 distribution hubs.

**Source document/event:** The report rests on the company's formal press release, issued after an extraordinary board meeting held on 11 March.
